task: Rank matrix: 3 responses x 3 parameter-range designs
cell_definition: Each cell is the 8-parameter ranking by |PRCC| under one (response, range) combination; all cells use n=2000 LHS samples with seed 20260816 (paired uniform variates across cells) and the Marino et al. (2008) estimator with df = n - 9. Static cells use the algebraic R0; dynamic cells use the 1,095-day baseline simulation (daily output grid, parabolically refined peak).

notes.beta_vh_hw50_capped_at_1: In the +/-50 % designs the upper bound of beta_vh (0.70*1.5 = 1.05) is capped at the probability bound 1.0; all other bounds follow the literal +/-50 %.
notes.peak_day_excluded: peak_day is reported in tasks A/D/G but excluded from the matrix: a static R0 has no timing counterpart, so a 3x3 matrix for it would be unbalanced.

meta.note: aggregation only; reuses tasks A/D/F/G results
